result.brief: 提出CTWM世界模型，用潜位移预测器与对数行列式正则恢复正确缩放的拉普拉斯表示，实现连续环境中的通勤时间保持与目标到达规划。
result.reason: Proposes commute-time-preserving latent world models with a displacement predictor and log-determinant regularizer for goal-reaching planning, directly matching world-model planning and latent dynamics interests.
